title: Drinking Water — Specification
qco_name: Drinking Water (Quality Control) Mandatory Statutory Order
source_authority: Bureau of Indian Standards / Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation

clauses.title: Essential Physical and Chemical Quality Parameters
clauses.text: Clause 4.1 & Table 1 (Organoleptic and Physical Parameters): Drinking water shall be clear, odourless, and agreeable in taste. Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) acceptable limit is 500 mg/L (permissible limit in absence of alternate source is 2000 mg/L). pH value acceptable limit is 6.5 to 8.5 (no relaxation). Turbidity acceptable limit is 1 NTU (max 5 NTU). Total Hardness as CaCO3 acceptable limit is 200 mg/L (max 600 mg/L). Chloride as Cl acceptable limit is 250 mg/L (max 1000 mg/L).

clauses.title: Toxic and Heavy Metal Contaminant Limits
clauses.text: Clause 4.2 & Table 2 (General Toxic Substances Limits in mg/L): Maximum permissible limits for heavy metals in drinking water: Lead (Pb) max 0.01 mg/L (no relaxation); Arsenic (As) max 0.01 mg/L (no relaxation); Mercury (Hg) max 0.001 mg/L; Cadmium (Cd) max 0.003 mg/L; Total Chromium (Cr) max 0.05 mg/L; Copper (Cu) max 0.05 mg/L (max 1.5 mg/L in absence of alternate source); Iron (Fe) max 1.0 mg/L; Fluoride (F) acceptable 1.0 mg/L (max 1.5 mg/L); Nitrate (NO3) max 45 mg/L (no relaxation).

clauses.title: Bacteriological Quality Requirements (Zero Tolerance)
clauses.text: Clause 5.1 & Table 6 (Bacteriological Quality of Drinking Water): All water intended for drinking must show zero presence (0 CFU/100ml) of Escherichia coli or thermotolerant coliform bacteria in any 100 ml sample. Total coliform bacteria shall be absent in 100 ml for treated piped supplies.
